Quote to Cash is the full business process from receiving customer orders through fulfillment, invoicing, payment collection, and reconciliation. evidence.title: Agentin | The Intelligence Layer on Enterprise Software
evidence.excerpt: Build the intelligence layer on top of enterprise software, so companies can run the workflows that move money with AI operators instead of manual coordination across systems. Agentin operates Revenue (Quote-to-Cash) and Spend (Procure-to-Pay) workflows on top of SAP, Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, Workday and Dynamics. Our agents watch orders, POs, invoices and tickets across these systems, and fix the ones that waste money or time before they hit your P&L. Every large company runs dozens of systems - ERP, CRM, procurement, ticketing - but the workflows that move money are still held together by email, spreadsheets and manual coordination. Agentin is building the intelligence layer on top of those systems: one AI brain that understands your customers, vendors, orders and POs across tools, and runs core workflows end-to-end. Agentin was founded by Sankeerth Rao Karingula, a YC founder with a background in machine learning and enterprise workflows. The company is based in San Francisco and works with global enterprises. We would love to show you how Agentin can work for your organization.
